artifact_review: The Router identified a 'texture_anomaly' (waxy shell) and 'boundary_blur'. This suggests the visual features (specifically the smooth, high-domed shell lacking distinct keels) lean towards a generic terrapin/pond turtle appearance rather than a distinct mud turtle. The 'boundary_blur' noted by the Router is likely depth-of-field blur given the sharp focus on the head, but the SAM mask confidence (0.99) indicates strong topological integrity. I will downgrade the severity of the boundary artifact to 1.0 (minor/optical) but maintain the texture anomaly as a slight alignment issue rather than a severe structural defect.
